title: 第3章 一日破八境第4章 太子妃劝谏失败
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
夏无恙少年时候修行的就是龙虎拳法，最高将其修行到了第三层圆满，对应着七品圆满之境，仅仅用了十几年时间。
若非为了打牢根基，未来才能够踏入更高层次，三十岁的时候只怕他已经修行到了六品以上，甚至是五品之境。
他原本的天赋资质还可以，虽然不算顶尖，却也是中上之姿，再加上大量天材地宝辅助，修炼速度并不慢。
如今重修龙虎拳法，那种滋味可想而知。
这门顶级炼体功法，早就被他参悟透彻，倒背如流不过等闲之事。
这段时间在吃喝玩乐的同时，夏无恙又重新参悟龙虎拳法，有了不少新的感悟，对其进行了细微的改良，更加契合他的身体。
“既然要重修龙虎拳法，那就从龙形桩开始！”
夏无恙双腿微分，身形如老树盘根，开始修行龙虎拳法：“龙形主静，虎形主动，龙虎交汇，方能够凝聚龙虎气血，拥有龙盘虎踞之姿。”
很快他就感觉到体内的血液开始沸腾起来，宛若水到渠成一般，竟然轻而易举地凝练出了龙虎气血，重新入品，踏入了修炼之路。
九品初期！
壮体之境！
夏无恙阖目凝神，感受着体内那条初生的暖流，四十二载寒暑，体内再次流淌气血之力的滋味，竟然让他眼角微微发涩。
那股暖流起初细若游丝，随着时间的推移渐渐壮大，在四肢百骸之间循环往复。
多年来服用天材地宝积累下来的药力，此刻被龙虎拳法吸收，化作了他成长的资粮。
夏无恙身上也带着几瓶滋补丹药，随时能够补充他的消耗。
气血之力迅速壮大，身体素质飞速提升，他的修为境界也在不断突破。
不对，准确地说不是突破，而是恢复。
九品中期！
九品后期！
九品圆满！

境界突破如水到渠成，很快重回八品之境，这一境界为炼皮境，顾名思义，需要对全身的皮膜进行淬炼和提升。
体内积累的药力还有很多，数十年的珍馐玉食，此刻尽数化作精元奔涌，那些沉淀在体内深处的药力，如春雪消融，滋养着每一寸重获新生的身体。
八品初期……气血如丝，渗入皮膜！
八品中期……皮膜坚韧，宛若牛皮！
八品后期……气血如潮，防御惊人！
八品圆满……皮膜如铁，刀枪难伤。
……
一个时辰的光景，竟然抵得过常人十年苦修。
他的实力重回八品圆满，再往上就是七品之境，也就是他被废之前所达到的境界。
几十年沉寂，一朝重回八品圆满，夏无恙也有些撑不住，不敢继续冲击下去，慢慢地开始平复躁动的气血。
七品的门槛虽然近在咫尺，却还需要时日沉淀。
此方世界的武道统共分为十品，分别是九品壮体、八品炼皮、七品炼肉、六品炼筋、五品炼骨、四品炼脏、三品炼腑、二品炼髓、一品换血……以及超品天人。
content_en:
Xia Wuyang practiced Dragon and Tiger Boxing when he was young, and it took only more than ten years to reach the third level of perfection, which corresponds to the seventh level of perfection.
If it were not for laying a solid foundation so that he could enter a higher level in the future, by the time he was thirty years old, he would have already reached the sixth level or above, or even the fifth level.
His original talents and qualifications were not bad. Although they were not top-notch, they were above average. Coupled with the support of a large number of heavenly materials and earthly treasures, his cultivation speed was not slow.
Now you can imagine the feeling of practicing Dragon Tiger Boxing again.
He had long understood this top-notch body-training technique, and it was easy for him to memorize it.
While eating, drinking and having fun during this period, Xia Wuyang re-understood the Dragon and Tiger Boxing, gained many new insights, and made subtle improvements to it to better fit his body.
"Since we want to rebuild the Dragon-Tiger Boxing technique, let's start with the dragon-shaped pile!"
Xia Wuyang's legs were slightly spread apart, and his body was shaped like an old tree with entwined roots. He began to practice the Dragon-Tiger Boxing Technique: "The dragon shape focuses on tranquility, and the tiger shape takes the initiative. Only when the dragon and tiger meet, can the energy and blood of the dragon and tiger be condensed, and the posture of the dragon coiling and the tiger sitting can be achieved."
Soon he felt that the blood in his body began to boil. As if everything came naturally, he easily condensed the dragon and tiger energy and blood, re-entered the rank, and embarked on the path of cultivation.
Early stage of ninth grade!
The state of strong body!
Xia Wuyan closed his eyes and concentrated, feeling the nascent warmth in his body. After forty-two years of cold and heat, the feeling of the power of blood flowing through his body again made the corners of his eyes feel slightly astringent.
The warm current was as thin as a gossamer at first, but gradually grew stronger over time, circulating back and forth between the limbs and bones.
The medicinal power accumulated from taking Tiancai Dibao for many years was now absorbed by Longhu Fist and turned into the material for his growth.
Xia Wuyang also carries several bottles of nourishing elixirs with him, which can replenish his consumption at any time.
The power of Qi and blood is rapidly growing, his physical fitness is improving rapidly, and his cultivation realm is also constantly breaking through.
No, not exactly a breakthrough, but a recovery.
The middle stage of ninth grade!
Late stage of ninth grade!
Nine levels of perfection!
The realm breakthrough came naturally, and he soon returned to the eighth level. This realm is the skin refining realm. As the name suggests, the skin membrane of the whole body needs to be tempered and improved.
There is still a lot of medicinal power accumulated in the body. Decades of delicacies and delicacies have all turned into essence and surged at this moment. The medicinal power accumulated deep in the body is like spring snow melting, nourishing every inch of the reborn body.
In the early stage of the eighth grade... Qi and blood are like silk, seeping into the skin membrane!
Mid-eighth grade...the skin is tough, like cowhide!
In the late eighth stage...the energy and blood are like tides, and the defense is astonishing!
Eighth-grade perfection...the skin is like iron and is invulnerable to swords and guns.
…
The sight of one hour is actually worth ten years of hard training for an ordinary person.
His strength has returned to the eighth level of perfection, and further up is the seventh level, which is the state he reached before he was deposed.
After decades of silence, Xia Wuyang once returned to the eighth level of perfection. He couldn't hold on anymore and didn't dare to continue the impact. He slowly began to calm down his restless energy and blood.
Although the threshold of seventh grade is close at hand, it still needs time to settle.
The martial arts system in this world is divided into ten levels, namely, ninth-level body strengthening, eighth-level skin refining, seventh-level meat refining, sixth-level tendon refining, fifth-level bone refining, fourth-level viscera refining, third-level viscera refining, second-level marrow refining, first-level blood exchange... and super-level heavenly beings.
